resources.string: It isn\'t TV time right now!
Settings are locked. A parent can open them from the phone.
No Tailscale address found. Open Tailscale on this TV and connect it first.

string-array.name: bedtime_lines
string-array.item: It\'s still sleeping time. Back to bed: sleep helps you grow!
Even the sun isn\'t up yet. Go back to sleep for a while!
The morning can wait. Snuggle back under the covers!
A good sleep now means more energy to play later. Back to bed!

resources.string: On a phone connected to Tailscale, open:\n%1$s
Up and down change a digit, left and right move; number keys work too. OK tries it, Back closes.
No recovery code is set on this TV. A parent makes one on the phone page: More, Recovery code.
Wrong code. %1$d more misses and the next try waits 1 min; after 3 misses, each miss waits 10 min.
Too many misses: try again in %1$d min.
Right code (it is used up now: make a new one on the phone page). What now?
Up and down to choose, OK to do it.

string-array.name: recovery_menu
string-array.item: Unlock and open the TV settings for 15 min
Unlock and clear the PIN (set a new one on the phone page)
